question: Which of the following best distinguishes the three concepts introduced in this course?

options.A: Ethics, deontology, and professionalism are interchangeable terms
options.B: Ethics asks "what is the right thing to do," deontology asks "what duties must be upheld regardless of outcome," and professionalism asks "what kind of person should a doctor be"

options.D: Professionalism is a subset of deontology
